metadata.title: Add Strale to MCP catalog (Data & Compliance)
metadata.author: petterlindstrom79

description:
Adds Strale as a remote MCP server in the catalog (`mcp-catalog.yml`) plus a contributor doc (`docs/strale.md`).

Strale exposes a catalog of data capabilities for AI agents — IBAN/VAT/LEI validation, company registry lookups across 27 countries, sanctions and PEP screening, web extraction, document parsing, and Web3 wallet/token intelligence. Every execution returns structured JSON with provenance.

- Transport: Streamable HTTP at `https://api.strale.io/mcp`
- Auth: Bearer token (API key from https://strale.dev/signup)
- Free tier: five capabilities work without an API key (`email-validate`, `iban-validate`, `dns-lookup`, `url-to-markdown`, `json-repair`)
- npm package (stdio): `strale-mcp`

Two files changed: `mcp-catalog.yml` (catalog entry) and `docs/strale.md` (registration walkthrough with curl examples).
